rules.owner: module of the first ir_model_data row (lowest id) registering the model (model=ir.model) or the relation field (model=ir.model.fields); every other registering module must depend on it transitively (ir_module_module_dependency)
rules.orm_framework: table name starts with ir_ or orm_signaling_
rules.exclude_tables: shared_postgresql + orm_framework objects of kind table, passed to pipeline.py as --exclude-table
